source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a retrospective study of 97 NF1 patients who had electrodesiccation of cutaneous and subcutaneous neurofibromas, a mean of 450 lesions were removed per session with minimal scarring, minor discomfort and high patient satisfaction.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 94 Levine 2008 PMID 17531563. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Retrospective; the procedure is not a drug.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 94
